5 reasons AI-built prototypes never reach production (and the Kiro fix)

Five reasons your AI prototype never reaches production.

1. No docs - Nobody wrote down what it should do.
2. No design decisions - Choices were made, but never recorded.
3. No validated requirements - Nobody checked what was actually needed.
4. No task plan - Work happens in random order.
5. No guardrails - Every prompt starts from zero.
